subject: Data Engineering
title: Schema Evolution in Streams
description: A micro-lesson that makes Schema Evolution in Streams usable.

hook.text: Version 1 events have 5 fields. Version 2 adds a sixth. Old consumers can't parse it. The stream breaks.

buildup.text: In long-lived streams, event schemas must evolve without breaking existing consumers.

discovery.text: Backward compatible changes add optional fields. Forward compatible changes ignore unknown fields.

twist.text: Formats like Avro and Protobuf support schema evolution natively. JSON does not enforce it.

climax.text: A schema registry combined with compatibility checks prevents breaking changes from reaching production.

punchline.text: Evolve the schema. Don't break the consumers.

quiz.question: What makes a schema change backward compatible?
options: Adding optional fields that old consumers can ignore
